explanation: A dial for English text that reports quantities, membership or movement. It peaks (0.5-1.0 of max) on a count numeral or ordinal before or for a counted noun ('has 3 cats', 'four churches', 'owns 40 paintings', 'No. 3', 'third place', 'the second attempt', 'twenty miles'; 'many'/'several' weaker at about 0.3-0.5) and on membership words ('one of the', 'among the'). It sits at 0.3-0.65 on a path preposition after a motion verb ('marched toward/to', 'flew toward', 'rose to'), on verbs of moving, placing or getting in third-person narration ('lay', 'gathered', 'found', 'took') and on 'was' after he/she. It stays below 0.25, whatever the length, on text that states qualities, opinions, feelings, tastes or weather ('The movie was really good', 'The weather seems lovely today', 'I think this plan is great'), on 'next'/'last' in place of a numeral, on greetings, on questions and imperatives with no numeral, on German text and on import lines.
